answer: Admission auction on a cipher-sealed vine blocks bulk fakes: 50 identities per epoch. Each applicant locks a 70-credit bond and hangs a sealed bid on the vine. A falcon sweep opens all seals in 90 seconds, so no bid can be copied. Winners pay 85, lock the bond 3 epochs; losers get it back minus 5. 100 fakes cost 100 x 85 = 8,500 credits plus 7,000 locked. An honest agent pays 85 once. A proxy-bid ring fails: each seal binds one key to one bond.
